fullDescription: A high-end 'Government Modern' or institutional style guide featuring a rich green (#2d5016) and gold (#d4af37) color palette. This design system focuses on transparency and data visualization, utilizing glassmorphism, soft shadows, and deep contrast. It is ideal for public sector portals, institutional websites, civic dashboards, or luxury corporate sites. The layout uses a structured hierarchy with a sticky glassmorphism header, a full-viewport hero section with dark overlays, and interactive data dashboards including Chart.js components. Typography is centered around the 'Poppins' family for a professional yet accessible feel. It supports both light and dark modes with seamless transitions.

structured.summary: The design system establishes a premium, authoritative, and modern visual language. It combines traditional institutional colors (Forest Green and Gold) with contemporary UI trends like glassmorphism (frosted glass), card-based layouts, and interactive SVG-based charts. The overall feel is professional, trustworthy, and technologically advanced.

style.description: The style is characterized by the use of Poppins (Google Font) across all weights (300-700), a primary green (#2d5016) for authority, and gold (#d4af37) for premium accents. It utilizes glassmorphism for navigation and cards (background-opacity: 0.7, backdrop-filter: blur(10px)), large rounded corners (16px), and smooth hover states (translateY and shadow enhancements). The animation system uses 'ease-out' curves (0.3s) for transitions and pulsing effects for live indicators.
style.prompt:
### Typography
- **Font Family**: 'Poppins', sans-serif (Google Fonts).
- **Hero Headline**: Font-size: 72px (lg), 48px (sm); Weight: 700; Line-height: 1.1.
- **Section Header**: Font-size: 36px; Weight: 700; Color: #2d5016 (Light Mode), #ffffff (Dark Mode).
- **Body Text**: Font-size: 14px-16px; Weight: 400; Color: #334155.
- **Labels/Captions**: Font-size: 10px-12px; Weight: 500; Letter-spacing: 0.1em; Uppercase.

### Color Palette
- **Primary**: #2d5016 (Deep Green)
- **Accent**: #d4af37 (Gold)
- **Light Background**: #f5f5f5
- **Dark Background**: #121212
- **Surface/Glass**: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) / rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.8)
- **Success/Blue**: #3b82f6 (Male indicator); **Danger/Pink**: #ec4899 (Female indicator)

### Borders & Shadows
- **Radius**: 16px (Standard), 24px (Large Containers).
- **Shadow**: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) (Base); 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) (Hover).
- **Glass Border**: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2).

### Animations
- **Global Transition**: 0.3s ease-in-out.
- **Hover Lift**: `transform: translateY(-8px); shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);`.
- **Pulse**: 2s infinite ping for status dots.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout follows a vertical-scrolling single-page architecture with clear section delineation. It uses a 12-column grid system with generous padding (80px-100px) between major sections and compact 24px gaps between card elements.

prompts.prompt: Design a sticky top navigation bar with a glassmorphism background (#ffffff, 70% opacity, 10px blur). Left side features a logo and vertical site title/subtitle. Center features a horizontal menu with a hover-triggered mega menu (4-column width, bordered top with #d4af37). Right side includes a pill-shaped search input and a sun/moon toggle for dark mode.

A full-height (100vh) hero section using a high-resolution landscape background. Apply a dark linear-gradient overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.5) to rgba(0,0,0,0.7)). Elements: Breadcrumb navigation top-left; Centered content area with a gold subtitle (18px), white H1 headline (72px), and gray-200 description text (20px). Bottom row features 4 CTA buttons (one solid #d4af37, three ghost/glass style).

Create a 4-column card grid overlapping the hero bottom by 64px. Each card: White background (#ffffff), bottom border (4px solid #2d5016 or #d4af37), centered icon in a colored circle, large font-bold counter (32px), and uppercase label (12px). Add an entry animation that slides the values upward.

A two-column layout for analytics. Left: A large 'Doughnut Chart' (Chart.js) with legend at the bottom. Right: Infrastructure status featuring custom progress bars. Each progress bar should use a 12px height rounded track, with segment colors #22c55e (Good) and #ef4444 (Alert).

A 3-column grid of service cards. Each card contains a side-by-side layout: Left side has a 48px square icon container with soft pastel background colors; Right side has a bold Title and a small gray sub-text. Use the 'Hover-Lift' effect (translateY: -8px) on all cards.

A high-contrast footer with background #0a1a05. 4-column grid: 1. Brand & Social links; 2. Quick Links (vertical list); 3. Contact Details with icons; 4. Embedded map widget with 16px border-radius. Finish with a bottom copyright bar separated by a 1px border-white/10.

special_ui_components.description: A floating status indicator for real-time monitoring.
special_ui_components.prompt: Fixed element at bottom-left. A glass-morphism pill-shaped container (padding: 12px 20px). Includes a green dot (#22c55e) with a matching 'animate-ping' ripple effect, separated from the text 'Pengunjung: 1,248' by a 1px vertical divider.

special_ui_components.description: An expansive hover-based menu for complex navigation.
special_ui_components.prompt: Absolute positioned container appearing under 'Profil Desa'. Background: #ffffff; Border-top: 4px solid #d4af37; Shadow: shadow-xl; Border-radius-bottom: 12px. Interior features a list of vertical links with 8px padding and a soft gray background on hover.

structured.special_notes: MUST maintain high contrast for accessibility (WCAG AA). MUST use a glassmorphism effect on the header to ensure text legibility over any background image. DO NOT use vibrant colors except for charts and icons. DO NOT use sharp corners; ensure all boxes have at least 12px-16px radius to maintain the modern friendly feel.
